run_metadata.coverage_summary: WebSearch-only discovery run. External WebFetch remained fully blocked by the environment egress proxy (EGRESS_BLOCKED) — reconfirmed this run against www.tenders.gov.au and www.vendorpanel.com.au — even though the proxy status endpoint reports healthy (enabled:true, bundleCoversEveryHost:true, recentRelayFailures empty), i.e. an organisation-level egress policy rather than a transient fault. Consequently NO tender detail page or specification document could be opened; every opportunity is captured at headline level, and detail fields are drawn only from WebSearch result link titles (which carry the target page's own <title>, e.g. 'Current ATM View - <ID>: AusTender' or '<title> - <RFT ID> | buy.nsw', treated as reliable for existence/status/ID) plus WebSearch answer snippets (treated as unverified for exact dates and scope, and flagged as such in each entry's notes). Tier 1 Commonwealth (AusTender) and all eight state/territory portals (NSW buy.nsw, VIC Buying for Victoria, QLD QTenders/supply.qld.gov.au, WA Tenders WA, SA Tenders SA, TAS Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, ACT Tenders) were probed via search. AusTender surfaced three verifiable Current-ATM link titles NOT present in the routine's 483 known dedup keys: CSIRORFT2026022 (CSIRO Labware and Chemicals Panel, publish 18-Sep-2026, close 14-Oct-2026 per snippet — recent), GA2026/564 (Geoscience Australia, no further detail via search), and RFI/2026/ASCQ (an RFI; buyer not identifiable from link title). buy.nsw surfaced four verifiable Destination NSW / Vivid Sydney individual opportunity link titles not previously captured (RFT-2011237 Volunteer Management, RFQ-2010692 Event Decking/Staging/Scaffolding, RFT-2012417 2026 Drone Show, RFT-2005682 2026-2028 Festival Director Services). Wingecarribee Shire Council RFT T-2026-16 (Church Road & David Woods Sports Fields lighting upgrades, close 12-Oct-2026 per snippet, on buy.nsw) and a Transgrid demand-management tender for >=40MW in Sydney's CBD (Powering Sydney's Future; confirmed via Transgrid's own news article, individual event login/registration-gated on Transgrid iBuy/SAP Ariba) were also captured — both with specifics drawn from search snippets/news prose and flagged pending detail-page verification. Other AusTender/buy.nsw link titles returned by search were already-known dedup keys (ASCA-RFT-2026-LDTPM, ATM_2026_2982, OPC-2026-02, OET-DRC-2026, GA2026/1392, PR10031930-RASS, ATM_2026_3512, RFI_ATM_2026_6026) or closed. WA/SA/TAS/NT/ACT/QLD returned only portal landing/search pages or aggregator results with no verifiable individual buyer link title (SA site had a scheduled outage 17-Sep; TAS reported 3 new tenders in last 7 days; ACT '2 Change Managers' posted 15-Sep; NT Power and Water tender closing 12-Oct — all headline prose only, not captured). Tier 2 (VendorPanel councils, universities/TAFEs, GBE utilities, CSIRO, public health) sampled: university EOIs (USYD Campus Master Plan, UTS Connected Assessment closing 18-Sep, Univ Adelaide Poultry Roof Replacement closing 21-Sep) surfaced only via aggregator (australiantenders.com.au) prose without a buyer link title and were NOT captured; DFAT AusConnect QIF EOIs (RFT26-002/003/005) had already closed 13-Sep-2026. Tier 3 was attempted per mandate (SAP Business Network Discovery/Ariba, BHP Become-a-supplier/Local Buying Program, Woolworths, Coles-via-Ariba, Qantas): all corporate opportunity detail is registration- or invitation-gated and none was publicly visible via search, so corporate portals are recorded in discovered_sources only, never fabricated as tenders. Source-discovery pass ran: candidate buyer pages found (Wingecarribee Shire wsc.nsw.gov.au tenders page, Audit Office of NSW open tenders, Sutherland/Hornsby/Logan councils, Townsville HHS, Queensland Health tenders, federal Supplier Portal suppliers.tenders.gov.au opening to all ABN holders from 1-Jul-2026) were all already in the routine's 341 known sources — no genuinely NEW buyer-originated source surfaced this run. Novel domains encountered (tenderhub.com.au, bidsfactory.com, australiatenders.com, consolidatedtenders.com, qld2032.com, australiantenders.com.au, tendersinfo.com, bidio.ai, tenders.net, tendersgo.com, tenderimpulse.com) are third-party aggregators/scrapers, excluded per the buyer-originated rule (usable only as discovery signal).
gaps: WebFetch/egress fully blocked (EGRESS_BLOCKED) for ALL external hosts this run — confirmed against www.tenders.gov.au and www.vendorpanel.com.au. No tender detail page or specification document could be opened; all nine captured tenders remain at headline level and require an authenticated/unblocked run for deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, exact dates, documents and contacts.

CSIRORFT2026022 (AusTender): publish (18-Sep-2026) and close (14-Oct-2026 2:00pm ACT) dates and the 'Labware and Chemicals Panel' scope are drawn from a WebSearch answer snippet, not the detail page; treat as provisional until an unblocked run verifies.

GA2026/564 (AusTender): only the Current-ATM link title was verifiable; title text, buyer beyond the GA (Geoscience Australia) prefix inference, category, dates, value and scope are all unavailable and recorded null.

RFI/2026/ASCQ (AusTender): Current-ATM link title verifiable but buying agency not identifiable from the ID/link title (detail page egress-blocked); buyer recorded "" rather than guessed; it is an RFI so no closing/deliverables captured.

Destination NSW / Vivid Sydney buy.nsw opportunities (RFT-2011237, RFQ-2010692, RFT-2012417, RFT-2005682): individual opportunity link titles are verifiable (carry the page <title> incl. RFT/RFQ ID and buyer) but the detail pages are egress-blocked; closing dates, scope, evaluation criteria, value and contacts could not be read and are null. A separate Vivid Sydney 'Site Management Services' RFT (reportedly closing 29-Sep-2026) appeared only in answer prose without a verifiable link title and was NOT captured per the no-fabrication rule.

Wingecarribee Shire Council RFT T-2026-16 (buy.nsw): buyer's own tenders page and the RFT ID are verifiable, but the title/scope (Church Road & David Woods Sports Fields lighting upgrades) and closing date (12-Oct-2026 15:00) are from a WebSearch snippet, not the detail page — flagged provisional.

Transgrid demand-management tender (Sydney CBD, >=40MW, Powering Sydney's Future): confirmed open via Transgrid's own news article, but the actual sourcing event is on Transgrid's iBuy / SAP Ariba portal (registration-gated) with no publicly visible ID, closing date or specification; value/dates/deliverables null and access set free-registration.

State/territory portals (WA, SA, TAS, NT, ACT, QLD): only landing/search pages or aggregator results returned; no verifiable individual buyer link title surfaced. SA Tenders had a scheduled maintenance outage on 17-Sep-2026. TAS (3 new in last 7 days), ACT ('2 Change Managers' posted 15-Sep), and NT (Power and Water, closing 12-Oct) items appeared only in answer prose and were deferred, not captured.

Tier 2 universities/TAFEs & public health: USYD Campus Master Plan EOI, UTS Connected Assessment Ecosystem EOI (closing 18-Sep-2026), University of Adelaide Poultry Roof Replacement (closing 21-Sep) surfaced only via aggregator (australiantenders.com.au) snippet prose without a buyer link title and were not captured; DFAT AusConnect QIF EOIs RFT26-002/003/005 had already closed 13-Sep-2026. Full portal sweep deferred pending unblocked WebFetch.

Tier 3 corporate (SAP Business Network Discovery/Ariba, BHP, Woolworths, Coles-via-Ariba, Qantas): opportunity detail is registration-/invitation-gated and none publicly visible via search; portals recorded in discovered_sources only, no corporate tender fabricated.

No genuinely new buyer-originated source found this run; all candidate buyer pages surfaced were already among the 341 known sources, and novel domains encountered were aggregators/scrapers excluded by policy.
